packages.name: wp-php-toolkit/reprint-server

suggest.ext-openssl: Needed to verify public-key signatures; hosts without it accept HMAC connection tokens only.
suggest.ext-pdo: Needed for the SQLite export path; recommended for MySQL exports (the wpdb fallback handles MySQL when absent).
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Recommended for MySQL exports; falls back to wpdb when absent.

packages.description: Streaming export engine used by the Reprint Server WordPress plugin
